name: Wilting Spinach Salad
description: A warm spinach salad with garlic, almonds, and a balsamic vinegar dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and tear spinach. Dry and pat with a tea towel.
In a small skillet, heat olive oil and crush garlic into it.
Add almonds and stir until lightly browned.
Add balsamic vinegar and turn off heat.
Immediately pour the hot dressing over the spinach salad and toss.
Serve immediately.

keywords: spinach salad, wilting spinach, warm salad

_similar.name: Spinach Lettuce Salad
_similar.description: A fresh and versatile green salad with a homemade balsamic dressing and a crunchy topping made from toasted almonds, sesame seeds, and noodle soup mix.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg noodle soup mix (without seasoning packet)
Any type of green leafy vegetable (spinach, lettuce, broccoli, coleslaw)

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the dressing ingredients together and refrigerate until ready to use.
Melt butter in a pan and add almonds, noodle soup mix (without spice packet), and sesame seeds. Toast until lightly browned.
Prepare the salad greens and store in the refrigerator.
Just before serving, pour the dressing over the salad and top with the toasted almond mixture.

_similar.keywords: spinach salad, lettuce salad, homemade dressing, crunchy topping

_similar.name: Strawberry Tossed Salad
_similar.description: A fresh and fruity salad with mixed greens, strawberries, and a sweet vinaigrette.
recipeIngredient: 4 cups torn Bibb or Boston lettuce
1 cup (4 oz) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
½ cup slivered almonds, toasted or coated with sugar
¼ cup cider or red wine vinegar

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the first 7 ingredients (oil, sugar, vinegar, garlic, salt, paprika, and white pepper) in a jar with a tight-fitting lid and shake well to make the dressing.
Just before serving, toss salad greens, strawberries, cheese, and almonds in a large salad bowl.
Drizzle with the prepared dressing and toss to coat.

_similar.keywords: strawberry salad, fruit salad, sweet salad dressing

_similar.name: Spinach Dip
_similar.description: A creamy spinach dip made with sour cream, mayonnaise, and Knorr vegetable soup mix, served in a hollowed-out pumpernickel bread loaf.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (300 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 can (10 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped

recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze excess moisture from the thawed spinach.
In a bowl, combine the spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, Knorr soup mix, water chestnuts, and green onions. Stir until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
If using a bread loaf, scoop out a large hollow through the top and fill with the dip mixture. Serve with bread cubes cut from the centre and/or assorted fresh vegetables.

_similar.keywords: spinach dip, party appetizer, pumpernickel bread

_similar.name: Mandarin Orange Salad
_similar.description: A classic spinach and lettuce salad with mandarin oranges and toasted almonds, dressed with a sweet and tangy homemade vinaigrette.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and clean the romaine lettuce, red tip lettuce, and spinach. Dry thoroughly and rip into bite-sized pieces.
In a saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar, mustard, and salt. Bring to a boil, then allow to cool.
Once cooled, blend the dressing mixture in a blender until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the prepared lettuce mixture about 10 minutes before serving.
Just before serving, add the drained mandarin oranges and toasted slivered almonds.

_similar.keywords: mandarin orange salad, spinach salad, homemade dressing

_similar.name: Sliced Bean Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and sweet pickled bean salad made with green or yellow beans, perfect for serving with onion and cream.

recipeInstructions.text: Slice the beans and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork.
Drain the cooked beans and pack them into jars.
In a saucepan, bring the sugar, water, vinegar, and salt to a boil to make the syrup.
Pour the hot syrup over the beans in the jars.
To serve, pour off the liquid and add chopped onion and cream.

_similar.keywords: pickled bean salad, sweet and tangy, preserved beans
